evidence.title: Database connection pool capacity model

evidence.title: Payment v142 ledger fan-out exhausted the connection pool
evidence.observation: Active database connections reached 50 of 50, acquisition timeouts increased, and payment p95 latency regressed.

evidence.title: Incident evidence correlation standard
evidence.observation: Temporal correlation alone is insufficient; include a causal mechanism, conflicting evidence, and a stable source URI for every retrieved document.

evidence.title: Retry storm containment
evidence.observation: Measure retry amplification against original request volume and dependency error rate. Apply retry budgets, exponential backoff, and circuit breaking before increasing downstream capacity.

evidence.title: Downstream timeout isolation
evidence.observation: Compare dependency p95 latency and timeout rate by edge. Confirm the upstream remains healthy, bound retries, and isolate the single regressing dependency before changing global timeout values.
